nodes.title: 🆎 AusBoss
Video Crop + Rotate + Pad → Clip - Your video

widgets_values: Write a video-generation prompt describing the shot in this image as one flowing paragraph of 60 to 100 words in the present tense. Treat it as a wide shot: describe the visible scenery together with the scenery that naturally surrounds it to the sides, as one continuous view. Begin directly with the subject or the setting. Cover the setting, the subjects and what they are doing, the lighting and time of day, colours and materials, the weather, and the camera framing. Only what can be seen: no moods, feelings, smells or temperature, no real place names, no camera movement unless it is clearly happening, no new people, text or watermarks. Use plain, restrained wording and present-progressive verbs for anything moving, such as water rippling or mist drifting. Never mention the image, the frame, black bands, bars, borders, cropping or outpainting, and never say that something lies outside or beyond the view. Output only the paragraph.

nodes.title: Add your video as the guide
Stitch Inpaint - Put your video back
Note
widgets_values: The empty latent takes the size and length of your padded clip, and the prompt its frame rate. Your frames are prepared as the guide.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Your frames go in as the guide, and the IC-LoRA paints the black bands. 8 steps and CFG 1 are the distilled LoRA's settings.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Your video goes back on top, with a 32 px blend along its edge. Tone match stays off, so moving things don't flicker.
